verificationInstructions: To verify signatures, rebuild EIP-712 typed data (domain name "Bifrost Assets", version "1", chainId of the provider network, salt keccak256("https://bifrostwallet.com") when the signed info includes acknowledgedResponsibilities) with primary type ProviderListing from the provider's info.json without logoURL, listed, managementGroup, domainLinked, dualNetwork, firstTransaction, delegationAddress, signingPolicyAddress, submitAddress, submitSignaturesAddress, publicKey, and validators: human-readable signed fields, linksJson (JSON.stringify of the sorted links object), acknowledgedResponsibilities (bool) when present, and contentHash (bytes32 SHA-256 of that canonical signed JSON). Recover the signer via eth_signTypedData_v4. contentHash must equal messageHash in signatures.json.
